assumptions: All recipes, people, products, IDs, amounts, prices and reviewed evidence premises are SYNTHETIC.
No quantity establishes meal adequacy, age suitability, nutrition or actual cooking/storage safety.
Rational strings such as 7/12 are evidence notation; consumer maps them into frozen decimal-string numerator/denominator types.
Symbolic IDs/digests/reason labels are fixture vocabulary, not new public contract fields/enums.
base_case references are local fixture inputs plus the explicitly named replacement; no production output is inherited.
Positive cases assume required provenance, scoped synthetic dietary/portion evidence and storage instructions except when a case explicitly removes them.
All offset timestamps are explicit Europe/London BST instants in these examples; no DST transition is hidden.
Pack search examples have one objective: minimum applicable full spend then minimum surplus, within 0..8 of each pack. They avoid an unresolved spend-versus-waste preference tradeoff.
Plan maxima are inclusive48h general/24h rice from original cook; shorter declared limits win. Cooling delay never extends the fixture clock.
No automation, retailer write, calendar publication or production acceptance is established.
